summary: Receives Ncam Reality camera-tracking, projection, optical-property, and timecode data over TCP for virtual production camera sync.

key_concepts: Ncam CHOP is available only in TouchDesigner Pro.
It receives camera tracking data from an external Ncam Reality system.
The documented network transport is TCP.
Outputs can include camera position, orientation, projection, optical properties, and timecode.
The output channels are intended to drive Camera COMP settings for synced virtual production rendering.
Ncam TOP can receive image data from the camera for compositing with rendered content.
common_gotchas: Only TCP is documented; do not plan UDP or serial Ncam input modes.
A valid Ncam server network address and port are required before live tracking will work.
Output channel sets depend on Camera View, Camera Projection, Camera Properties, and Timecode settings.
Camera properties may be normalized 0-1 or physical units, so downstream unit assumptions need to be explicit.
